why: Both share the same strong core of aged brown leather sofa, wood-and-black-metal table and bookcase, and black floor lamp. A's large jute chevron rug delivers the earth tones the client asked for and warms up against the light oak floor and beams. B's grey rug with white fringe drifts from the requested palette, and its plain plant pot is less industrial than A's oxidized faceted metal planter.
